plugins.name: webapp-testing-checklist
plugins.description: Walk a web application penetration test through the OWASP WSTG methodology as a structured checklist and produce WSTG-numbered findings. Checklist/report-generation aid in backseat mode — normal benign traffic is fine, but it never sends attack payloads or exploit attempts; actual security testing is the tester's job.
